title: Vegan Tofu "Eggs"
description: Crumbled firm tofu mimics scrambled eggs in texture and when mixed with plant-based milk, nutritional yeast, and spices, can be a quick and tasty vegan meal to start off your day.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package firm tofu, drained and patted dry
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Generously spray a skillet with olive oil cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Add tofu, using your hands to crumble the block into smaller pieces; cook for 4 minutes.

Stir in nutritional yeast, 1/2 teaspoon salt, garlic powder, and turmeric. Cook until seasonings have been incorporated, breaking tofu apart with a spatula to desired consistency, about 1 minute. Stir in almond milk and cook until absorbed, about 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.
